items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.mul_apply_antidiagonal
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Add M] (x y : AddMonoidAlgebra R M) (m : M)
  (s : Finset (M × M)), (∀ {p : M × M}, p ∈ s ↔ p.1 + p.2 = m) → (x * y) m = ∑ p ∈ s, x p.1 * y p.2

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.mul_apply
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Add M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq M]
  (x y : AddMonoidAlgebra R M) (m : M),
  (x * y) m = Finsupp.sum x fun m₁ r₁ => Finsupp.sum y fun m₂ r₂ => if m₁ + m₂ = m then r₁ * r₂ else 0

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.mul_apply_left
items.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {R : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddGroup G] (x y : AddMonoidAlgebra R G) (g : G),
  (x * y) g = Finsupp.sum x fun h r => r * y (-h + g)
